title: 第154章 开棺
slug: 黄牛中介没想到你请得动真神啊
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

季伯渊直起身来，眼眶微微泛红。

他活了数百年，见过太多生死，但这一刻，面对一个沉睡了四千年的古人，面对一个为了苍玄界付出了一切的剑修，他还是忍不住心头发颤。

“张先生。”季伯渊转过身来，声音有些沙哑，“接下来……该怎么办？”

张瑀收回目光，语气平静：“开棺。”

季伯渊愣了一下。

“陆清寒已经沉睡了四千年，她的修为从化神后期跌落到了元婴巅峰。”张瑀说，“封印灵力只剩不到一成，就算我们不主动开棺，她也撑不了多久了。”

他顿了顿，语气郑重了几分。

“与其让她在棺材里悄无声息地耗尽最后一丝生机，不如现在就把她唤醒。她为了苍玄界付出了这么多，不该就这么默默无闻地消逝。”

季伯渊沉默了片刻，然后用力点了点头：“好！就依张先生所言。”

二长老在旁边忍不住问了一句：“张小友，开棺之后，她会不会……失控？毕竟是四千年前的人物，又沉睡了这么久，万一醒来之后意识不清——”

“有这个可能。”张瑀没有回避这个问题，“她沉睡的时间太久了，苏醒之后会有一段短暂的意识模糊期，届时可能会本能地释放剑气护体。”

他转过身，看向千机阵师。

“千机先生，麻烦你在棺材周围布置一道隔灵阵，把苏醒瞬间的剑气余波控制在三丈范围内。”

千机阵师点了点头，从腰间解下铜盘，十指在盘面上飞快拨动。

一道道纤细的金色光丝从盘面上蔓延开来，贴着地面往宫殿深处延伸过去。

光丝在棺材周围交织成一张极其复杂的阵图，每一根光丝都精准地连接到了石柱上的符文节点上。

不过片刻工夫，隔灵阵便布置完成。

千机阵师抬起头来，语气依然平静：“隔灵阵已成，三丈之内，剑气余波不会外泄。但若她的修为恢复到化神期以上，隔灵阵的压制力可能会不足。”

“足够了。”张瑀说。

他转过身，又看向掌刑天官。

“天官大人，开棺之后，如果她失控，麻烦你出手压制。不用伤她，只需稳住她的剑气，等她意识恢复。”

掌刑天官微微颔首：“依法办事。”

张瑀深吸了一口气。

所有准备都已就绪。

他迈开步子，重新走进了通道。

掌刑天官跟在他身后，千机阵师留在通道入口处操控隔灵阵，季伯渊和几位长老守在外围，所有人的目光都落在张瑀的背影上。

直播间里的弹幕也紧张了起来。

【要开棺了！我的心脏都快跳出来了！】

【四千年啊！棺材一开，就是见证历史的时候！】

【我好怕她醒来之后接受不了现实，宗门没了，同门没了，一切都变了】

Page (1/3)

Ji Boyuan straightened up, his eyes slightly red.

He had lived for hundreds of years and had seen too many lives and deaths, but at this moment, facing an ancient who had been sleeping for four thousand years, and a sword cultivator who had given everything for the Cangxuan Realm, he could not help but feel his heart tremble.

"Mr. Zhang." Ji Boyuan turned around, his voice a little hoarse, "What should we do next...?"

Zhang Yu withdrew his gaze and said calmly: "Open the coffin."

Ji Boyuan was stunned for a moment.

"Lu Qinghan has been sleeping for four thousand years. Her cultivation has dropped from the late stage of divine transformation to the peak of Nascent Soul." Zhang Yu said, "Less than 10% of the sealed spiritual power is left. Even if we don't take the initiative to open the coffin, she won't be able to survive for long."

He paused and his tone became more solemn.

"Instead of letting her quietly exhaust her last breath of life in the coffin, it is better to wake her up now. She has paid so much for the Cangxuan World and should not just disappear in obscurity."

Ji Boyuan was silent for a moment, then nodded vigorously: "Okay! Just follow what Mr. Zhang said."

The second elder couldn't help but ask: "Zhang Xiaoyou, after opening the coffin, will she... lose control? After all, she was a person from four thousand years ago, and she has been asleep for so long. What if she wakes up and loses consciousness -"

"It is possible." Zhang Yu did not avoid the question. "She has been sleeping for too long. After waking up, there will be a brief period of confusion. At that time, she may instinctively release the sword energy to protect her body."

He turned around and looked at the Thousand Machine Formation Master.

"Mr. Qianji, please arrange a spirit barrier around the coffin to control the aftermath of the sword energy within three feet of the moment of awakening."

The Thousand Machine Formation Master nodded, took off the copper plate from his waist, and moved his fingers quickly on the plate.

Thin strands of golden light spread from the disk, sticking to the ground and extending deep into the palace.

The light filaments were intertwined around the coffin to form an extremely complex array, and each light filament was accurately connected to the rune nodes on the stone pillars.

In just a moment, the Spirit Separation Formation was completed.

The Qianji Formation Master raised his head, his tone still calm: "The Spirit Separation Formation is complete, and the sword energy's aftermath will not leak within three feet. But if her cultivation returns to above the God Transformation stage, the suppression power of the Spirit Separation Formation may not be enough."

"That's enough." Zhang Yu said.

He turned around and looked at the official in charge of punishment.

"Master Tianguan, after opening the coffin, if she loses control, please take action to suppress her. There is no need to hurt her, just stabilize her sword energy and wait for her to regain consciousness."

The official in charge of punishment nodded slightly: "According to the law."

Zhang Yu took a deep breath.

All preparations are in place.

He took a step forward and entered the passage again.

The Xingtian official followed behind him, the Thousand Machine Formation Master stayed at the entrance of the passage to control the Spirit Separation Formation, Ji Boyuan and several elders guarded the outside, and everyone's eyes fell on Zhang Yu's back.

The barrage in the live broadcast room also became tense.

【The coffin is about to be opened!My heart almost jumped out of my chest!】

【Four thousand years!Once the coffin is opened, it’s time to witness history!】

[I'm so afraid that she won't be able to accept the reality after she wakes up. The sect is gone, her classmates are gone, and everything has changed]
